facts.value: The Department of Economics provides student advising for various questions related to studies.

The E! Week with its mentoring program is the ideal start for all Bachelor students; it includes a three-day program to introduce first-semester students to Goethe University, the department, campus life, and the city of Frankfurt.
Master students are warmly welcomed at the Master Welcome Day and receive important information.

The event series 'Bachelor meets Business' aims to create a forum for exchange between science and practice, inviting a selection of companies each winter semester; master's students are also welcome.
The Dean's List honors outstanding academic achievements and facilitates exchange between students and companies; this special honor is awarded each semester to the best Bachelor and Master students.

The first-semester week (E! Week) offers the opportunity to meet student initiatives within the department; interested individuals can find more information on the department's website about the work, current projects, and engagement opportunities in student initiatives and the student council.
All Bachelor and Master graduates receive an invitation to the graduation celebration, where the degree completion is traditionally celebrated with gowns.
Important dates for informational events can be found on the student service page along with student news.
